title: detect_numeric_columns
description: Test detect_numeric() with DataFrame containing mixed column types to verify it returns correct list of numeric columns and returns empty list for empty DataFrame.

title: detect_categorical_columns
description: Test detect_categorical() with DataFrame containing mixed column types to verify it returns correct list of categorical (object/string) columns.

title: detect_datetime_columns
description: Test detect_datetime() with DataFrame containing datetime columns to verify it returns correct list of datetime columns.

title: dataset_summary_complete
description: Test dataset_summary() with a DataFrame to verify it returns a dictionary with keys 'numeric', 'categorical', and 'datetime' containing respective column lists.

title: load_csv_file
description: Test load_csv() with valid CSV file path to verify it returns a pandas DataFrame and with invalid path to verify it raises FileNotFoundError with Spanish error message.

title: load_excel_file
description: Test load_excel() with valid Excel file path to verify it returns a pandas DataFrame.

title: preview_loaded_data
description: Test preview_data() with loaded DataFrame to verify it returns first 5 rows by default and first N rows when rows parameter is specified.

title: get_loaded_dataframe
description: Test get_dataframe() after loading a file to verify it returns the currently loaded DataFrame.

title: export_data_to_csv
description: Test to_csv() with a DataFrame to verify it returns CSV bytes encoded in UTF-8 without DataFrame index.

title: generate_text_summary_report
description: Test to_summary_text() with DataFrame containing all expected columns to verify it returns formatted text report and with missing columns to verify it generates partial report.
